decisions.what: Added data-reveal attributes and initial animation classes (opacity-0 translate-y-8 transition-all duration-500 ease-out) to gallery h2, 8 gallery item divs (data-delay 0-700ms), brand story h2, 2 brand story articles (data-delay 0/100ms), and footer columns in both footers (data-delay 0/100/200ms).
decisions.why: Spec required these exact elements to receive data-reveal and hidden initial state classes, to be toggled by the JavaScript Intersection Observer on scroll.

decisions.what: Added scroll reveal functionality to app.js inside a DOMContentLoaded listener: prefers-reduced-motion guard, IntersectionObserver with threshold 0.2 and rootMargin '0px 0px -20% 0px', class swap (opacity-0/translate-y-8 removed, opacity-100/translate-y-0 added), setTimeout stagger via data-delay attribute, and unobserve after reveal.
decisions.why: Spec explicitly required these parameters, behaviors, and initialization timing.
